description: This file defines the UpgradeHistory class, which manages the upgrade history records in the SuiteCRM system. It includes methods for querying, checking, and managing upgrade records, as well as handling versions and dependencies.

classes.name: UpgradeHistory
classes.description: Handles upgrade history records for SuiteCRM, including CRUD operations, version comparisons, and dependency checks.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes this upgrade record from the database.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the upgrade history object and disables row-level security.

methods.name: getAllOrderBy
methods.description: Retrieves all upgrade records ordered by a specified field.

methods.name: checkForExisting
methods.description: Checks if an upgrade record with the same name or id_name exists.

methods.name: determineIfUpgrade
methods.description: Determines if the current record indicates an upgrade by comparing versions.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all upgrade records ordered by date entered.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Builds and returns a list of upgrade records based on a provided query.

methods.name: findByMd5
methods.description: Finds upgrade records matching a specific md5 checksum.

methods.name: UninstallAvailable
methods.description: Checks if an upgrade can be uninstalled based on existing patches.

methods.name: foundConflict
methods.description: Checks for conflicts between two file or directory paths.

methods.name: is_right_version_greater
methods.description: Compares two version arrays to check if the right version is greater or equal.

methods.name: checkDependencies
methods.description: Verifies if specified dependencies are installed with appropriate versions.

methods.name: retrieve
methods.description: Retrieves a record, ignoring deletion status.

methods.name: getPackageDateString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the package's date entered or modified.

methods.name: getPackageTimestamp
methods.description: Converts a date string to a timestamp.
